text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses, saying:
text_cn: 上主训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Make two silver trumpets; you shall make them of hammered work; and you shall use them for summoning the congregation, and for breaking camp.
text_cn: “你要制造两个喇叭，用银打成，用为召集会众，为迁移营幕。

text_en: When both are blown, the whole congregation shall assemble before you at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
text_cn: 几时吹两个喇叭，全会众都应集合在会幕门口，来到你跟前。

text_en: But if only one is blown, then the leaders, the heads of the tribes of Israel, shall assemble before you.
text_cn: 若只吹一个喇叭，以色列的千夫长，作首领的应集合到你跟前。

text_en: When you blow an alarm, the camps on the east side shall set out;
text_cn: 若吹紧急号，扎在东方的营就起程；

text_en: when you blow a second alarm, the camps on the south side shall set out. An alarm is to be blown whenever they are to set out.
text_cn: 第二次吹紧急号时，扎在南方的营就起程：吹紧急号是为叫他们起程；

text_en: But when the assembly is to be gathered, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.
text_cn: 但为召集会众，只吹号，不应紧急吹。

text_en: The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets; this shall be a perpetual institution for you throughout your generations.
text_cn: 亚郎的子孙作司祭的应吹号：这为你们世世代代是条永久的规定。

text_en: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets, so that you may be remembered before the Lord your God and be saved from your enemies.
text_cn: 几时你们在本国要出去作战，攻打来侵的仇敌，应吹紧急号，使上主你们的天主，记得你们，救你们脱离仇敌。

text_en: Also on your days of rejoicing, at your appointed festivals, and at the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and over your sacrifices of well-being; they shall serve as a reminder on your behalf before the Lord your God: I am the Lord your God.
text_cn: 此外，在你们的庆日、节日、月朔之日，献全燔祭及和平祭时，还应吹号，使你们的天主记得你们：我是上主，你们的天主。”

text_en: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud lifted from over the tabernacle of the covenant.
text_cn: 第二年二月二十日，云彩由会幕升起，

text_en: Then the Israelites set out by stages from the wilderness of Sinai, and the cloud settled down in the wilderness of Paran.
text_cn: 以色列子民就从西乃旷野循序起程出发。以后云彩在帕兰旷野停住了。

text_en: They set out for the first time at the command of the Lord by Moses.
text_cn: 他们初次依照上主藉梅瑟所出的命令起程。

text_en: The standard of the camp of Judah set out first, company by company, and over the whole company was Nahshon son of Amminadab.
text_cn: 首先依队起程的，是犹大子孙的营旗，率领军队的，是阿米纳达布的儿子纳赫雄；

text_en: Over the company of the tribe of Issachar was Nethanel son of Zuar;
text_cn: 率领依撒加尔子孙支派军队的，是族阿尔的儿子乃塔乃耳；

text_en: and over the company of the tribe of Zebulun was Eliab son of Helon.
text_cn: 率领则步隆子孙支派军队的，是厄隆的儿子厄里雅布。

text_en: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites, who carried the tabernacle, set out.
text_cn: 拆下帐幕后，革尔雄的子孙和默辣黎的子孙，就抬着帐幕起程出发。

text_en: Next the standard of the camp of Reuben set out, company by company; and over the whole company was Elizur son of Shedeur.
text_cn: 以后依队出发的，是勒乌本的营旗，率领军队的，是舍德乌尔的儿子厄里族尔；

text_en: Over the company of the tribe of Simeon was Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,
text_cn: 率领西默盎子孙支派军队的，是族黎沙待的儿子舍路米耳；

text_en: and over the company of the tribe of Gad was Eliasaph son of Deuel.
text_cn: 率领加得子孙支派军队的，是勒乌耳的儿子厄里雅撒夫。

text_en: Then the Kohathites, who carried the holy things, set out; and the tabernacle was set up before their arrival.
text_cn: 此后刻哈特人抬着圣所之物起程；当他们达到时，人应已竖起帐幕。

text_en: Next the standard of the Ephraimite camp set out, company by company, and over the whole company was Elishama son of Ammihud.
text_cn: 以后依队出发的，是厄弗辣因子孙的营旗，率领军队的，是阿米胡得的儿子厄里沙玛；

text_en: Over the company of the tribe of Manasseh was Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,
text_cn: 率领默纳协子孙支派军队的，是培达族尔的儿子加默里耳；

text_en: and over the company of the tribe of Benjamin was Abidan son of Gideoni.
text_cn: 率领本雅明子孙支派军队的，是基德敖尼的儿子阿彼丹。

text_en: Then the standard of the camp of Dan, acting as the rear guard of all the camps, set out, company by company, and over the whole company was Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
text_cn: 以后依队出发的，是作全营后卫的丹子孙的营旗，率领军队的，是阿米沙待的儿子阿希厄则尔；

text_en: Over the company of the tribe of Asher was Pagiel son of Ochran,
text_cn: 率领阿协尔子孙支派军队的，是敖革兰的儿子帕革厄耳；

text_en: and over the company of the tribe of Naphtali was Ahira son of Enan.
text_cn: 率领纳斐塔里子孙支派军队的，是厄南的儿子阿希辣。

text_en: This was the order of march of the Israelites, company by company, when they set out.
text_cn: 这是以色列子民出发时，依队起程的次序。

text_en: Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are setting out for the place of which the Lord said, ‘I will give it to you’; come with us, and we will treat you well; for the Lord has promised good to Israel. ”
text_cn: 梅瑟对自己的岳父，米德杨人勒乌耳的儿子曷（hé）巴布说：“我们正要起程往上主曾说：‘我要给你们的那地方’去；你同我们一起去吧！我们必要好待你，因为上主对以色列许下了幸福。”

text_en: But he said to him, “I will not go, but I will go back to my own land and to my kindred. ”
text_cn: 曷巴布回答他说：“我不去，我要回到故乡我的老家去。”

text_en: He said, “Do not leave us, for you know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you will serve as eyes for us.
text_cn: 梅瑟说：“请你不要离开我们！因为你知道我们在旷野安营的地方，你要给我们当向导。

text_en: Moreover, if you go with us, whatever good the Lord does for us, the same we will do for you. ”
text_cn: 你若同我们一起去，我们必使你分享上主要赐与我们的幸福。”

text_en: So they set out from the mount of the Lord three days’ journey with the ark of the covenant of the Lord going before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them,
text_cn: 他们就由上主的山起程出发， 行了三天的路程；三天的路程中，上主的约柜走在他们的前面，为他们寻求休息的地方。

text_en: the cloud of the Lord being over them by day when they set out from the camp.
text_cn: 白天他们移营前行时，上主的云彩常在他们头上。

text_en: Whenever the ark set out, Moses would say, “Arise, O Lord , let your enemies be scattered, and your foes flee before you. ”
text_cn: 当约柜起行时，梅瑟就说：“上主，请你起来，使你的仇敌溃散，使怀恨你的由你面前逃走。”

text_en: And whenever it came to rest, he would say, “Return, O Lord of the ten thousand thousands of Israel. ”
text_cn: 在约柜停留时，他就说：“上主，请归来，住在以色列千家万户中。”
